bindings.name: B12
bindings.description: Deployable ::HashRelay.DesktopAgent — PROPOSED (D-M2-01, D-M2-04, D-M2-05, D-M2-07, D-M2-08). A signed, notarized .app menu-bar agent.

configuration.ui: AppKit NSStatusItem menu-bar extra; LSUIElement (no Dock icon); pairing window in AppKit
configuration.signing: Developer ID Application certificate, hardened runtime; identity via secretLocator env://MACOS_SIGNING_IDENTITY
configuration.notarization: xcrun notarytool submit --wait, then xcrun stapler staple; App Store Connect API key via secretLocator env://APPLE_NOTARY_API_KEY
configuration.distribution: notarized .dmg; the user drags HashRelay.app to ~/Applications (no admin) or /Applications
configuration.startAtLogin: SMAppService.mainApp login item, toggled from the menu, visible in System Settings > General > Login Items
configuration.uninstall: menu item and hashrelay agent uninstall: revoke grant, delete Keychain items, unregister login item, quit, move app to Trash
configuration.diagnostics: ~/Library/Logs/HashRelay; menu Export Diagnostics writes a zip of logs and status JSON, secrets redacted
configuration.ci: GitHub Actions macOS runner: build, sign, notarize, staple, publish to the release channel

bindings.name: B13

bindings.name: B14
bindings.description: Service ::HashRelay.Notifications.Delivery.DeliveryService — Realtime delivery to connected agents: hub /hubs/notifications, Hello binds the connection to the endpoint, replay of unacknowledged deliveries flagged replayed; FCM HTTP v1 push for mobile endpoints. Unchanged by M2; macOS and Linux agents use the same hub protocol.

configuration.push: FCM HTTP v1 via Services/Push/FcmPushSender.cs; credential secretLocator HashRelay:Push:Fcm:ServiceAccountJson

bindings.name: B15
bindings.description: Service ::HashRelay.Notifications.Delivery.EndpointService — Endpoint registration, unchanged by M2: the platform in Hello and POST /api/v1/endpoints is a free string (trimmed to 32 chars, lowercased; EndpointService.RegisterAsync), so macos and linux need no server change.

configuration.platforms: free string; agents send windows, macos or linux

bindings.name: B17
bindings.description: Service ::HashRelay.Notifications.EndpointAgent.AgentRuntime — PROPOSED. The shared platform-neutral runtime (src/HashRelay.Client: RelayListener, NotificationPresenter, OneClickApprovals) with macOS adapters.

configuration.library: src/HashRelay.Client (net10.0); protocol unchanged: pairing device flow, hub Hello on every (re)connect with platform=macos, ack, replay, duplicate suppression, catch-up summary
configuration.notificationAdapter: UNUserNotificationCenter: requestAuthorization(alert, sound); a UNNotificationCategory for approvals with Approve/Reject UNNotificationActions; didReceive response goes to OneClickApprovals or opens the review page
configuration.updater: in-agent updater: signed release manifest from the release channel, Developer ID team-ID check of the new bundle before swapping it in
